title: Boxty Gyoza
description: A Japanese twist on traditional Irish boxty, these pan-fried dumplings are filled with a crispy potato and xtra-rich filling.
instructions: 1. In a pan over medium heat, crisp-fry the Xtra until golden brown.
2. In a separate bowl, mash the grated potatoes and crumbled Irish boxty together.
3. Add the crispy Xtra to the potato mixture and stir until combined.
4. Lay out the gyoza wrappers on a flat surface.
5. Place a spoonful of the potato mixture onto the center of each wrapper.
6. Dip your finger in water and run it along the edges of the wrapper.
7. Fold the wrapper into a triangle, pressing the edges together to seal.
8. Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and add a small amount of oil.
9. Pan-fry the gyoza until golden brown on the bottom.
10. Flip the gyoza over and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
